Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.
p

Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.

li

li
Manage own accounts, secondary to DOSM Key accounts from various segments.
li
Conduct a minimum of 60 Sales Calls a month, 10 Client’s entertainments and site inspections.
li

li
Approach personal sales activities from a strategic perspective, understanding the relative importance and priority of the current account base, and directing personal MICE sales efforts accordingly.
li
Continually review the actual production of each account against the potential for that account, and review suggestions for improvement with department leadership.
li
Focus on assertively establishing new client contacts and developing detailed information on the potential revenues from these accounts.
li
Achieve personal financial and non-financial performance objectives, working with department leadership to ensure these objectives are met.

Take responsibility for your own professional development, ensuring that you have the financial literacy, negotiation and face-to-face selling skills needed to successfully do your job.

Maintain accurate management status reporting on business results, and associated action planning.

li

li
Drive opportunities to upsell and cross-sell Anantara products

li
Ensure that all administration is processed quickly and efficiently.
